spec.name: National Ahwach Festival
spec.description: National festival in Ouarzazate dedicated to ahwach, the collective sung dance of the High and Anti-Atlas performed by men and women in traditional tribal dress. Troupes from across southern Morocco gather to perform and pass the art on.

editions.notes: Rescheduled from the usual period due to the COVID-19 pandemic
